authorization: 2026-09-17 user requests checklist, fitting scientific details at assistant discretion; pilot before any 500k recomputation
single_input_format: literal selected field, no empty-field separator; tokenizer adds usual special tokens
title_abstract: reuse original exact outputs, unchanged native separators and limits
analysis_unit: Field pooled across five periods: 1000 rows; equal contribution of each period
primary_shape: debiased linear CKA; retain primary v1 preprocessing
shape_check: Spearman cosine distance ranks on 20000 same paper pairs

neighbors.candidates: same 1000 papers per Field for every model/input
neighbors.precision: float64 exact; 12 decimal ties, global row_index

effects.model: mean dissimilarity to other nine models on identical input
effects.input: same model, dropping title, dropping abstract, and title vs abstract reported separately
effects.scale: 1-CKA and 1-neighbor-overlap separately; no claim 1-CKA is a metric
effects.balanced: each Field and model equal weight
effects.secondary: average all three input transitions versus all three same-input model comparisons

stability.interpretation: finite-pilot sensitivity of model-minus-input contrast; no population confidence interval

escalation: no automatic full-500k rerun; use pilot stability and exact missing question to decide targeted next preparation

temporal.shape: full cells, checked against saved medians of 2048 selections
summaries: paired endpoint changes by Field and model pair
OLS slope over five periods; no causal historical claims
temporal.inference: descriptive fixed models; no IID pair tests

comparisons: model x Field residual after Field and pair means
discipline.interpretation: localize disagreement, not establish a causal training mechanism

families.interpretation: descriptive dyadic regression and model-label permutation reference; no random sample of models, no causal effect of training, broad domain is not measured corpus overlap
